svg.aria-label: Cabling, front view of U11 and U12. Every device uses an odd port on the top row of the access switch SWAGGER-ACCESS-SW01, and each cord drops straight down to the patch panel port below it: panel port N connects to switch port 2N minus 1. Every cord carries a flag label with its panel port and device. Panel 1 to Gi1/0/1, admin PC, VLAN 10. Panel 2 to Gi1/0/3, AP-1, trunk for VLANs 20 and 30. Panel 3 to Gi1/0/5, AP-2, trunk for VLANs 20 and 30. Panel 4 to Gi1/0/7, internal PC, VLAN 20. Panels 5 to 8 to Gi1/0/9, 11, 13 and 15, four PoE cameras, VLAN 50. Panel 9 to Gi1/0/17, NVR, VLAN 50. Panel 10 to Gi1/0/19, R720 NIC1, VLAN 10. Panel 11 to Gi1/0/21, R720 NIC2, trunk for VLANs 20 and 40. Panel 12 to Gi1/0/23, UNAS Pro, VLAN 40. Even ports and ports 25 to 48 are shut down. Te1/0/1-2 uplink to the core as Po1. Panel ports 1 to 8 are wall runs, 9 to 12 come from devices in the rack, and 13 to 24 are spare. Cord colors follow the VLANs; trunk cords are striped.
svg.title: Cabling
